Season.reasoning: Describes the temporal period of the sampling event.

Cultivation.reasoning: Describes the habitat or treatment condition of the sampling.

Q1.reasoning: Represents the first quartile of the measured data.

Q2 (Median).reasoning: Represents the median of the measured data.

Q3.reasoning: Represents the third quartile of the measured data.

IQR.reasoning: Represents the interquartile range of the measured data.
